description: CASEWORK C3 in face frame: the V3021's melamine carcass with a white oak 1x2 frame (2 stiles 30, 3 rails 27), a 28 x 6 false front and two 13.9375 x 21.5 doors overlaying it 1/2 in. model.json is the plugin's expansion with the member materials documents applies; members.json each body's member metadata (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_cabinets.py pins both).
derivation: Every expectation is ANALYTIC, from services/geometry/tests/test_casework.py's independent script of casework.md's conventions (spec(), C1 typed from its table), never from the plugin: each panel a box, a notched side its box less its 3 x 4.5 toe notch; summed in exact rational arithmetic (x 25.4 = mm exactly).
surface_area = each panel's box area, a notched side's less twice its notch's face; bodies are separate.
topology: a box 6 faces, 12 edges, 1 shell; a notched side 8 faces, 18 edges. MESH: a box 24 vertices and 12 triangles, a notched side 36 and 20 (two hexagons of 4 triangles, six quads of 2).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), 2026-10-23: volume 7.5e-9 mm^3 off the exact sum over 15 bodies; 1e-7 is 13x.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-23: the STEP round trip moves the re-summed VOLUME by 1.04e-7 mm^3 (2e-15 relative); 5e-7 is 4.8x; volume and area only.
